sentences.text: On September 14, 2026, Snickerwood ER documented a rear-end collision, cervical strain, neck pain 5/10, and a prescription for ibuprofen 800 mg.
On October 5, 2026, Plumtree Physical Therapy documented in its evaluation that cervical range of motion was reduced and pain was 5/10.
On October 19, 2026, Dr. Ophelia Marchbanks documented pain of 4/10 and a return visit in 4 weeks.
On November 16, 2026, Dr. Ophelia Marchbanks documented pain of 2/10.
